name: INTRDRJ2.JCL
description:
This JCL job copies data from a backup file to an internal reader file within the CardDemo application, effectively reproducing or resubmitting stored job streams or data records from a backup source to a target dataset designated for internal reader processing.Key Functionalities:
Reads data from the CardDemo FTP test backup dataset (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP) as the source input.
Copies all records from the input backup file to the internal reader target dataset (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP.INTRDR) using the REPRO function.
The REPRO operation performs a direct, complete reproduction of all records from the source to the destination without any filtering or transformation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Demo FTP Test Backup file (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP) is available and contains records to be processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The IDCAMS REPRO command is executed to transfer data from the Card Demo FTP Test Backup file to the Internal Reader file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Every record from the Card Demo FTP Test Backup is copied completely and without any modification or transformation to the Card Demo FTP Backup Internal Reader file (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP.INTRDR); no records are skipped, filtered, or altered during the transfer

rules.Rule_Name: IDCAMS - IDCAMS REPRO - Complete Record Transfer from Card Demo FTP Backup to Internal Reader
rules.Rule_Description: All records from the Card Demo FTP Test Backup file must be fully copied to the Internal Reader file without any modification, filtering, or selection criteria applied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The IDCAMS REPRO job step is initiated to transfer Card Demo FTP Backup data to the Internal Reader
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to access the source file (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP) and the destination file (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP.INTRDR)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Both the Card Demo FTP Test Backup file and the Internal Reader file must already exist and be accessible in shared mode; if either file is unavailable or inaccessible, the data transfer must not proceed and the entire job must be treated as failed

rules.Rule_Name: IDCAMS - IDCAMS REPRO - Pre-existence of Source and Destination Files
rules.Rule_Description: Both the Card Demo FTP Test Backup (source) and the Internal Reader (destination) files must already exist and be accessible in shared mode before the data transfer operation can proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All records from the Card Demo FTP Test Backup have been successfully copied to the Internal Reader file (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP.INTRDR)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The data transfer to the Card Demo FTP Backup Internal Reader is completed without errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transferred data must be available in the Internal Reader, enabling downstream automated job submission or processing to be triggered using the Card Demo FTP Backup data

rules.Rule_Name: IDCAMS - IDCAMS REPRO - Internal Reader Activation for Downstream Processing
rules.Rule_Description: Upon successful completion of the data transfer, the Card Demo FTP Backup data written to the Internal Reader file becomes available to trigger downstream automated processing or job submission.
